task: Assess the credit and counterparty risk of Beyond Meat

nimble.claim: Beyond Meat, Inc. (Nasdaq: BYND) is a public company with no PE or single controlling sponsor; largest holders per WallStreetZen (2026): Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers XIV LLC 28.61%, Seth Goldman 10.60%, CEO Ethan Brown 5.10%.
Beyond Meat net revenues FY2025 were $275.5M, down 15.6% YoY.
Beyond Meat loss from operations FY2025 was $333.6M (operating margin -121.1%).
Beyond Meat Adjusted EBITDA FY2025 was -$179.3M (-65.1% of net revenues).
Beyond Meat cash and cash equivalents including restricted cash were $217.5M as of 2025-12-31.
Beyond Meat total debt carrying value (net of discount; 2027 Notes, 2030 PIK notes, DDTL) was $415.7M as of 2025-12-31.
Beyond Meat net cash used in operating activities FY2025 was $144.9M.
Beyond Meat net revenues Q1 2026 were $58.2M, down 15.3% YoY.
Beyond Meat loss from operations Q1 2026 was $41.1M.
Beyond Meat net loss Q1 2026 was $28.5M.
Beyond Meat cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash were $205.8M as of 2026-03-28.
Beyond Meat total debt was $411.6M as of 2026-03-28 (Q1 2026 10-Q).
Beyond Meat stockholders' deficit was $21.1M as of 2026-03-28.
Beyond Meat net revenues Q2 2026 were $68.8M, down 8.2% YoY.
Beyond Meat loss from operations Q2 2026 was $30.8M.
Beyond Meat net income Q2 2026 was $16.4M, driven by a $57.7M non-cash gain on debt extinguishment from 2030 Notes conversions.
Beyond Meat Adjusted EBITDA Q2 2026 was -$27.7M (-40.2% of net revenues).
Beyond Meat cash and cash equivalents including restricted cash were $186.1M as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat total debt carrying value (2030 PIK notes, 2027 Notes, DDTL) was $323.8M as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat net cash used in operating activities H1 2026 was $23.2M (vs $58.0M in H1 2025).

Beyond Meat completed an exchange offer in Oct 2025 (early settlement 2025-10-13, completed 2025-10-30): $1,114,603,000 (96.92%) of 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027 were exchanged into $196.2M of new 7.00% Convertible Senior Secured Second Lien PIK Toggle Notes due 2030 plus 316,150,176 shares (total new notes $208.7M including $12.5M SteerCo premium); covenants and certain events of default were stripped from the remaining 2027 Notes indenture.

Beyond Meat determined the Oct 2025 Exchange Offer qualified as a troubled debt restructuring (ASC 470-60); FY2025 net income of $219.0M included a $548.7M non-cash gain on debt restructuring, and about $17.6M of debt issuance costs were expensed.
Reuters reported Beyond Meat's debt swap was launched to help avoid near-term default and hugely diluted the stock.
Beyond Meat drew $100.0M in aggregate under the Delayed Draw Term Loan Facility with Unprocessed Foods, LLC (Ahimsa DDTL) during FY2025.
Beyond Meat received about $148.7M net proceeds from ATM common stock sales during FY2025.
Beyond Meat H1 2026 gain on debt extinguishment was $63.8M.

Beyond Meat on 2026-08-11 effected a 1-for-30 reverse stock split and authorized-share reduction to regain Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance; conversion rates of the 2027 and 2030 convertible notes and warrants were proportionately adjusted.

Beyond Meat on 2026-09-23 entered exchange agreements to retire about $15.0M principal of remaining 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027 at 96% of face value, settled in common stock (1,097,444 shares initially, up to 848,265 more at final settlement).
Beyond Meat, Inc. has no public credit rating from S&P, Moody's or Fitch on the issuer or its convertible notes (0% due 2027; 7% second lien PIK toggle due 2030); the notes appear unrated.
Beyond Meat laid off 6% of its workforce (~44 employees) on 2025-02-27 and suspended operations in China (~20 jobs, ~95% of local workforce).

Beyond Meat announced another layoff in Aug 2025 (44 employees, ~6% of global workforce, ~$0.8-1.3M severance, ~$7M annualized savings) and appointed AlixPartners MD John Boken as interim Chief Transformation Officer, targeting EBITDA-positivity in H2 2026.

Beyond Meat disclosed a material weakness in internal control over financial reporting on 2025-11-12 (inadequate technical resources for complex transactions) and delayed Q3 2025 earnings about a week.
Beyond Meat recorded $77.4M of non-cash impairment charges in Q3 2025.
Beyond Meat terminated corporate controller and principal accounting officer Yi (Jevy) Luo on 2025-12-18; CFO Lubi Kutua assumed principal accounting officer duties.
Beyond Meat disclosed on 2026-08-05 that it no longer satisfies Form S-3 eligibility and is unable to access its ATM Program.
Beyond Meat disclosed further material weaknesses with its delayed FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-04-09).
Reuters (2025-10-23): Beyond Meat's annual sales have declined since 2022, it has never had an annual profit, its 'survival hangs in the balance', and it has never flagged going-concern risk.
Beyond Meat customer-loss signal (Aug 2025): reports McDonald's removed McPlant from its Austrian menu and is running out its Beyond Meat contract; Q2 2025 US retail revenue dropped ~27%.

Creditsafe data: Beyond Meat's days-beyond-terms rose from 8 days in Aug 2024 to 19 days in Jul 2025 vs a 12-day industry average; Creditsafe said this indicates possible liquidity pressures; the company said it was not planning to file for bankruptcy.

exa.claim: Beyond Meat, Inc. is a public company with common stock listed on Nasdaq under BYND; the 2025 debt exchange materially diluted existing shareholders, with no verified change of control or PE sponsor.
Beyond Meat, Inc. net revenue was $68.832 million for the three months ended 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. operating loss was $30.806 million for the three months ended 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. adjusted EBITDA (company-defined, non-GAAP) was approximately -$27.7 million for the three months ended 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. had unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of $171.369 million as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. had current restricted cash of $5.516 million as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. had non-current restricted cash of $9.25 million as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. total debt outstanding was $323.796 million carrying value (net of discounts and issuance costs, excluding leases) as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. had $29.459 million of 2027 convertible notes outstanding as of 2026-06-27, maturing 2027-03-15.
Beyond Meat, Inc. had $0 remaining availability under its delayed-draw term loan facility as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. net cash used in operating activities was $23.156 million for the six months ended 2026-06-27.

Beyond Meat, Inc. completed final settlement of its convertible-debt exchange on 2025-10-30: 97.44% of 2027 notes exchanged, $209.721 million of second-lien 2030 notes issued (including steering-committee premium) and 317,834,446 common shares issued, leaving $29.459 million of 2027 notes; a major restructuring with substantial shareholder dilution.

Beyond Meat, Inc. reported covenant compliance under its 2030 notes as of 2026-06-27; the notes carry a $15 million quarterly minimum-liquidity covenant, mature 2030-10-15, and bear 7% interest (9.5% when paid in kind).
Beyond Meat, Inc.'s delayed-draw facility was fully drawn as of 2026-06-27.

Beyond Meat, Inc. executed a second supplemental indenture on 2026-08-10 removing certain restrictions on repurchasing or exchanging 2027 notes for cash and/or equity and extending the conversion interest make-whole period to 2029-01-15.

Beyond Meat, Inc. entered agreements on 2026-09-23 to exchange approximately $15 million principal of 2027 notes for common stock at 96% of face value, with 1,097,444 initial shares and up to 848,265 additional shares at final settlement around September 28, subject to closing conditions; completion not confirmed.

Beyond Meat, Inc. management stated in the June 27, 2026 10-Q that existing cash and anticipated operating cash flows should fund operations for the next twelve months, conditional on revenue, cash-flow and cost assumptions.
Beyond Meat, Inc. disclosed it cannot access its ATM equity program because it no longer satisfies Form S-3 eligibility, limiting financing flexibility.
Beyond Meat, Inc. quarterly revenue declined 8.2% year over year in the quarter ended 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc.'s reported net income for the quarter ended 2026-06-27 was driven primarily by a $57.7 million non-cash debt-extinguishment gain rather than profitable operations.
Beyond Meat, Inc.'s 10-Q filed 2026-08-06 continued to disclose existing material weaknesses in internal control over financial reporting and corrections to comparative-period accounting.
Beyond Meat, Inc. reported continuing charges from the cessation of China operations in 2025 and a partial headquarters lease termination.

Beyond Meat, Inc. leadership transition: Mr. Krishnaswamy began full-time employment on 2026-09-30 replacing interim COO David Boken, who was also to step down as interim Chief Transformation Officer effective 2026-10-07.
Food Dive (2024-08-21), citing Creditsafe data, reported that 36% of Beyond Meat, Inc.'s 2024 bills were at least 91 days overdue; the company called the figures highly inaccurate and disputed them.

In the Sonate trademark litigation (jury verdict 2025-11-24), a jury awarded $23.5 million actual damages and $15.4 million disgorgement against Beyond Meat, Inc., which recorded a $38.9 million litigation accrual; post-trial motions remained pending per the June 2026 10-Q.
Beyond Meat, Inc. settled a former co-manufacturer dispute in its favour for $11 million: $4 million received in June 2026 and $7.1 million including interest received 2026-07-10.
CreditRiskMonitor's undated preview flags tax-lien filings against Beyond Meat, Inc. with no date, amount or jurisdiction; unverified screening flag only.

firecrawl.claim: Beyond Meat, Inc. net revenue was $68.832 million for the three months ended 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. reported an operating loss of $30.806 million for the three months ended 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) was -$27.7 million for the three months ended 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. had unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of $171.369 million as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. had cash and cash equivalents including restricted cash of $186.1 million as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. total outstanding debt, carrying value net of debt discount, was $323.8 million as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat management stated that existing cash plus anticipated operating cash flows are sufficient to fund operations for the next 12 months as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat, Inc. debt agreements include a $15.0 million minimum liquidity covenant, tested quarterly (disclosed as of 2026-06-27).

On 2026-09-23 Beyond Meat entered privately negotiated exchange agreements for about $15.0 million principal of its remaining 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027 at 96% of face value, initially issuing 1,097,444 shares and potentially up to 848,265 additional shares under a VWAP true-up.

On 2025-10-30 Beyond Meat completed an exchange offer in which 97.44% of the 2027 Notes were tendered, resulting in issuance of $209.721 million of 7.00% Convertible Senior Secured Second Lien PIK Toggle Notes due 2030 and 317,834,446 new shares, accounted for as a troubled debt restructuring.
On 2025-05-07 Beyond Meat entered a Loan and Security Agreement for a delayed-draw term loan of up to $100.0 million; $40.0 million was drawn 2025-06-26 and $60.0 million on 2025-09-18.
Beyond Meat's delayed-draw term loan had $110.9 million outstanding including accrued PIK interest as of 2026-06-27, with no amount available to borrow.
Beyond Meat reported compliance with 2030 Notes and Loan and Security Agreement covenants as of 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat's debt agreements include a $60.0 million cap on cash used to repay the 2027 Notes at maturity, subject to stated exceptions.

On 2026-09-18 a federal court entered a $15.4375 million judgment against Beyond Meat in the Sonate trademark case ($37,500 actual damages plus $15.4 million disgorgement), subject to possible further motions or appeals.
Beyond Meat's revenue declined 8.2% year-over-year in the quarter ended 2026-06-27.
Beyond Meat had negative operating cash flow of $23.2 million for the six months ended 2026-06-27 and expects to continue operating at a loss for the foreseeable future.

Beyond Meat management concluded disclosure controls were not effective as of 2026-06-27 because two material weaknesses remain unremediated: accounting for non-routine and complex transactions, and inventory valuation/data integrity.

Beyond Meat ceased operational activities in China at the end of 2025 and is winding down the facility and lease, with workforce reductions, product-line exits and manufacturing/real-estate footprint optimization as part of its cost-reduction program.
Beyond Meat's interim Chief Transformation Officer John Boken stepped down effective 2026-10-07 after COO Brijesh Krishnaswamy started full-time on 2026-09-30, with responsibilities reassigned.

Beyond Meat, Inc. is publicly traded (NASDAQ: BYND); Millennium Management LLC, Millennium Group Management LLC and Israel A. Englander reported beneficial ownership of 957,442 shares (5.2%) under Schedule 13G, as of 2026-09-21, not filed to influence control.
